text_block_list.text:
While the competition between BNW is
tight,
Уиннинг Тикит takes first place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She wants to race against her rivals again
soon, so
with that in mind, we choose
the likeliest place
they'll be—the Osaka
Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Нарита Таисин and Biwa
Hayahide are
distant in their attitude
toward Уиннинг Тикит.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
